name: Progress bars compared
what: Under a title, four labelled grey bars fill with a soft light glow - one gets far, the others only a little - then the light turns into your accent colour and every bar rushes on to the same end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f68 the bars fill in a light colour with a glow, one to 75 % and the others to 10 % (all on one slow S-curve); f68-f108 hold; f108-f147 the light colour turns into the accent colour on the bars and all the texts (linear); f110-f148 every bar rushes on to 90 % (slow start, very fast middle, soft end)

tracks.name: first fill
tracks.what: the bars fill in a light colour, each to its first number

tracks.name: colour change
tracks.what: the bars, the glow, the names and the title turn from light to the accent colour

tracks.name: rush to the end
tracks.what: every bar goes on to its last number, all on the same curve
